`agau_history_revision()`, `agau_forecast_revision()` and
`agau_forecast_error()` are deliberately separate operations. Comparisons join
semantic observation keys, never row coordinates.

Forecast error defaults to the first later estimate or historical
observation. `realisation = "latest_revised"` is explicitly labelled and does
not overwrite the original error concept. Non-unique joins and incompatible
semantic bases fail with a typed validation error.
